verses.original: אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיַּ֥עַן וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·hū way·ya·‘an way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Elihu continued . . .

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ מִלָּ֑י חֲכָמִ֣ים הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ לִֽי׃ וְ֝יֹדְעִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū mil·lāy ḥă·ḵā·mîm ha·’ă·zî·nū lî wə·yō·ḏə·‘îm
verses.literal: Hear my words O wise men give ear to me O men of learning

verses.original: כִּי־ אֹ֭זֶן תִּבְחָ֑ן מִלִּ֣ין וְ֝חֵ֗ךְ יִטְעַ֥ם לֶאֱכֹֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ō·zen tiḇ·ḥān mil·lîn wə·ḥêḵ yiṭ·‘am le·’ĕ·ḵōl
verses.literal: For the ear tests words as the mouth tastes food

verses.original: נִבְחֲרָה־ לָּ֑נוּ מִשְׁפָּ֥ט נֵדְעָ֖ה בֵינֵ֣ינוּ מַה־ טּֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: niḇ·ḥă·rāh- lā·nū miš·pāṭ nê·ḏə·‘āh ḇê·nê·nū mah- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Let us choose for ourselves what is right let us learn together what is good

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אִיּ֣וֹב אָ֭מַר צָדַ֑קְתִּי וְ֝אֵ֗ל הֵסִ֥יר מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’î·yō·wḇ ’ā·mar ṣā·ḏaq·tî wə·’êl hê·sîr miš·pā·ṭî
verses.literal: For Job has declared I am righteous yet God has deprived me of justice

verses.original: אֲכַזֵּ֑ב עַל־ מִשְׁפָּטִ֥י חִצִּ֣י אָנ֖וּשׁ בְלִי־ פָֽשַׁע׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḵaz·zêḇ ‘al- miš·pā·ṭî ḥiṣ·ṣî ’ā·nūš ḇə·lî- p̄ā·ša‘
verses.literal: Would I lie about my case My wound is incurable though I am without transgression

verses.original: מִי־ גֶ֥בֶר כְּאִיּ֑וֹב יִֽשְׁתֶּה־ לַּ֥עַג כַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: mî- ḡe·ḇer kə·’î·yō·wḇ yiš·teh- la·‘aḡ kam·mā·yim
verses.literal: What man is like Job [who] drinks up derision like water

verses.original: וְאָרַ֣ח לְ֭חֶבְרָה עִם־ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וְ֝לָלֶ֗כֶת עִם־ רֶֽשַׁע׃ אַנְשֵׁי־
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·raḥ lə·ḥeḇ·rāh ‘im- pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen wə·lā·le·ḵeṯ ‘im- re·ša‘ ’an·šê-
verses.literal: He keeps company with evildoers . . . and walks with wicked men

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אָ֭מַר יִסְכָּן־ גָּ֑בֶר לֹ֣א בִּ֝רְצֹת֗וֹ עִם־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ā·mar yis·kān- gā·ḇer lō bir·ṣō·ṯōw ‘im- ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: For he has said It profits a man nothing that he should delight in God

verses.original: לָכֵ֤ן׀ שִׁמְע֫וּ לִ֥י אַ֥נֲשֵׁ֥י לֵבָ֗ב חָלִ֖לָה לָאֵ֥ל מֵרֶ֗שַׁע וְשַׁדַּ֥י מֵעָֽוֶל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên šim·‘ū lî ’a·nă·šê lê·ḇāḇ ḥā·li·lāh lā·’êl mê·re·ša‘ wə·šad·day mê·‘ā·wel
verses.literal: Therefore listen to me O men of understanding Far be it from God to do wrong and from the Almighty to act unjustly

verses.original: כִּ֤י אָ֭דָם פֹ֣עַל יְשַׁלֶּם־ ל֑וֹ אִ֝֗ישׁ וּֽכְאֹ֥רַח יַמְצִאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ā·ḏām p̄ō·‘al yə·šal·lem- lōw ’îš ū·ḵə·’ō·raḥ yam·ṣi·’en·nū
verses.literal: For vvv according to a man’s deeds He repays him according to a man’s ways He brings consequences

verses.original: אַף־ אָמְנָ֗ם אֵ֥ל לֹֽא־ יַרְשִׁ֑יעַ וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹֽא־ יְעַוֵּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- ’ā·mə·nām ’êl lō- yar·šî·a‘ wə·šad·day lō- yə·‘aw·wêṯ miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Indeed it is true that God does not act wickedly and the Almighty does not pervert justice

verses.original: מִֽי־ פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו אָ֑רְצָה וּמִ֥י שָׂ֝֗ם כֻּלָּֽהּ׃ תֵּבֵ֥ל
verses.transliteration: mî- p̄ā·qaḏ ‘ā·lāw ’ā·rə·ṣāh ū·mî śām kul·lāh tê·ḇêl
verses.literal: Who gave Him charge over the earth Who appointed [Him] [over] the whole world

verses.original: אִם־ יָשִׂ֣ים לִבּ֑וֹ אֵלָ֣יו יֶאֱסֹֽף׃ רוּח֥וֹ וְ֝נִשְׁמָת֗וֹ אֵלָ֥יו
verses.transliteration: ’im- yā·śîm lib·bōw ’ê·lāw ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ rū·ḥōw wə·niš·mā·ṯōw ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: If He were to set His heart to it and withdraw His Spirit and breath . . .

verses.original: כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֣ר יִגְוַ֣ע יָ֑חַד וְ֝אָדָ֗ם יָשֽׁוּב׃ עַל־ עָפָ֥ר
verses.transliteration: kāl- bā·śār yiḡ·wa‘ yā·ḥaḏ wə·’ā·ḏām yā·šūḇ ‘al- ‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: all flesh would perish together and mankind would return to the dust

verses.original: וְאִם־ בִּ֥ינָה שִׁמְעָה־ זֹּ֑את הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָה לְק֣וֹל מִלָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- bî·nāh šim·‘āh- zōṯ ha·’ă·zî·nāh lə·qō·wl mil·lāy
verses.literal: If you have understanding hear this listen to . . . my words

verses.original: הַאַ֬ף שׂוֹנֵ֣א מִשְׁפָּ֣ט יַחֲב֑וֹשׁ וְאִם־ תַּרְשִֽׁיעַ׃ צַדִּ֖יק כַּבִּ֣יר
verses.transliteration: ha·’ap̄ śō·w·nê miš·pāṭ ya·ḥă·ḇō·wōš wə·’im- tar·šî·a‘ ṣad·dîq kab·bîr
verses.literal: Could one who hates justice govern . . . Will you condemn the just and mighty One

verses.original: הַאֲמֹ֣ר לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בְּלִיָּ֑עַל אֶל־ נְדִיבִֽים׃ רָ֝שָׁ֗ע
verses.transliteration: ha·’ă·mōr lə·me·leḵ bə·lî·yā·‘al ’el- nə·ḏî·ḇîm rā·šā‘
verses.literal: who says to kings [You are] worthless and to nobles [You are] wicked

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ נָשָׂ֨א׀ פְּנֵ֥י שָׂרִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א נִכַּר־ שׁ֭וֹעַ לִפְנֵי־ דָ֑ל כִּֽי־ כֻּלָּֽם׃ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer lō- nā·śā pə·nê śā·rîm wə·lō nik·kar- šō·w·a‘ lip̄·nê- ḏāl kî- kul·lām ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏāw
verses.literal: who is not partial . . . to princes and does not favor rich over poor For they are all the work of His hands

verses.original: יָמֻתוּ֮ רֶ֤גַע׀ וַחֲצ֪וֹת לָ֥יְלָה עָ֣ם יְגֹעֲשׁ֣וּ וְיַעֲבֹ֑רוּ אַ֝בִּ֗יר וְיָסִ֥ירוּ לֹ֣א בְיָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: yā·mu·ṯū re·ḡa‘ wa·ḥă·ṣō·wṯ lā·yə·lāh ‘ām yə·ḡō·‘ă·šū wə·ya·‘ă·ḇō·rū ’ab·bîr wə·yā·sî·rū lō ḇə·yāḏ
verses.literal: They die in an instant in the middle of the night The people convulse and pass away the mighty are removed without human hand

verses.original: כִּי־ עֵ֭ינָיו עַל־ דַּרְכֵי־ אִ֑ישׁ יִרְאֶֽה׃ וְֽכָל־ צְעָדָ֥יו
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ê·nāw ‘al- dar·ḵê- ’îš yir·’eh wə·ḵāl ṣə·‘ā·ḏāw
verses.literal: For His eyes [are] on the ways of a man and He sees vvv his every step

verses.original: אֵֽין־ חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וְאֵ֣ין צַלְמָ֑וֶת שָׁ֝֗ם פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃ לְהִסָּ֥תֶר
verses.transliteration: ’ên- ḥō·šeḵ wə·’ên ṣal·mā·weṯ šām pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen lə·his·sā·ṯer
verses.literal: There is no darkness [or] deep shadow where the workers of iniquity can hide

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֝֗ל לֹ֣א עַל־ יָשִׂ֣ים אִ֭ישׁ ע֑וֹד לַהֲלֹ֥ךְ אֶל־ בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’êl lō ‘al- yā·śîm ’îš ‘ō·wḏ la·hă·lōḵ ’el- bam·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: For God need not . . . examine a man further [or] have him approach . . . for judgment

verses.original: יָרֹ֣עַ כַּבִּירִ֣ים לֹא־ חֵ֑קֶר וַיַּעֲמֵ֖ד אֲחֵרִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yā·rō·a‘ kab·bî·rîm lō- ḥê·qer way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ ’ă·ḥê·rîm taḥ·tām
verses.literal: He shatters the mighty without inquiry and sets up others in their place

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן יַ֭כִּיר מַעְבָּֽדֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָ֥פַךְ לַ֝֗יְלָה וְיִדַּכָּֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yak·kîr ma‘·bā·ḏê·hem wə·hā·p̄aḵ lay·lāh wə·yid·dak·kā·’ū
verses.literal: Therefore He recognizes their deeds He overthrows [them] in the night and they are crushed

verses.original: סְפָקָ֗ם תַּֽחַת־ רְשָׁעִ֥ים בִּמְק֥וֹם רֹאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: sə·p̄ā·qām ta·ḥaṯ- rə·šā·‘îm bim·qō·wm rō·’îm
verses.literal: He strikes them for their wickedness in full view

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ כֵּ֭ן סָ֣רוּ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֑יו לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃ וְכָל־ דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ‘al- kên sā·rū mê·’a·ḥă·rāw lō hiś·kî·lū wə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵāw
verses.literal: because . . . . . . they turned aside from Him and had no regard for any of His ways

verses.original: צַֽעֲקַת־ דָּ֑ל לְהָבִ֣יא עָ֭לָיו יִשְׁמָֽע׃ וְצַעֲקַ֖ת עֲנִיִּ֣ים
verses.transliteration: ṣa·‘ă·qaṯ- dāl lə·hā·ḇî ‘ā·lāw yiš·mā‘ wə·ṣa·‘ă·qaṯ ‘ă·nî·yîm
verses.literal: They caused the cry of the poor to come before Him and He heard the outcry of the afflicted

verses.original: וְה֤וּא יַשְׁקִ֨ט׀ וּמִ֥י יַרְשִׁ֗עַ וְיַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נִים וּמִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ וְעַל־ יָֽחַד׃ אָדָ֣ם גּ֖וֹי וְעַל־
verses.transliteration: wə·hū yaš·qiṭ ū·mî yar·ši·a‘ wə·yas·têr pā·nîm ū·mî yə·šū·ren·nū wə·‘al- yā·ḥaḏ ’ā·ḏām gō·w wə·‘al-
verses.literal: But when He remains silent who can condemn Him When He hides His face who can see Him Yet He watches over both man and nation . . .

verses.original: חָנֵ֗ף אָדָ֥ם מִ֭מְּלֹךְ מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי עָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·nêp̄ ’ā·ḏām mim·mə·lōḵ mim·mō·qə·šê ‘ām
verses.literal: that godless men should not rule or lay snares for the people

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הֶאָמַ֥ר אֶל־ אֵ֭ל נָשָׂ֗אתִי אֶחְבֹּֽל׃ לֹ֣א
verses.transliteration: kî- he·’ā·mar ’el- ’êl nā·śā·ṯî ’eḥ·bōl lō
verses.literal: Suppose someone says to God I have endured my punishment I will offend no more

verses.original: הֹרֵ֑נִי בִּלְעֲדֵ֣י אֶ֭חֱזֶה אַתָּ֣ה אִֽם־ פָּ֝עַ֗לְתִּי עָ֥וֶל לֹ֣א אֹסִֽיף׃
verses.transliteration: hō·rê·nî bil·‘ă·ḏê ’e·ḥĕ·zeh ’at·tāh ’im- pā·‘al·tî ‘ā·wel lō ’ō·sîp̄
verses.literal: Teach me what I cannot see . . . if I have done wrong I will not do it again

verses.original: יְשַׁלְמֶ֨נָּה הַֽמֵעִמְּךָ֬ כִּֽי־ מָאַ֗סְתָּ כִּי־ אַתָּ֣ה תִבְחַ֣ר וְלֹא־ אָ֑נִי דַבֵּֽר׃ וּֽמַה־ יָדַ֥עְתָּ
verses.transliteration: yə·šal·men·nāh ha·mê·‘im·mə·ḵā kî- mā·’as·tā kî- ’at·tāh ṯiḇ·ḥar wə·lō- ’ā·nî ḏab·bêr ū·mah- yā·ḏa‘·tā
verses.literal: Should God repay you on your own terms when you have disavowed Him . . . You must choose not I so tell me what you know

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לֵ֭בָב יֹ֣אמְרוּ לִ֑י חָ֝כָ֗ם וְגֶ֥בֶר שֹׁמֵ֥עַֽ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê lê·ḇāḇ yō·mə·rū lî ḥā·ḵām wə·ḡe·ḇer šō·mê·a‘ lî
verses.literal: Men of understanding will declare to me and the wise men who hear me [will say]

verses.original: אִ֭יּוֹב יְדַבֵּ֑ר לֹא־ בְדַ֣עַת וּ֝דְבָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א בְהַשְׂכֵּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·yō·wḇ yə·ḏab·bêr lō- ḇə·ḏa·‘aṯ ū·ḏə·ḇā·rāw lō ḇə·haś·kêl
verses.literal: Job speaks without knowledge his words lack insight

verses.original: אָבִ֗י אִיּ֣וֹב יִבָּחֵ֣ן עַד־ נֶ֑צַח עַל־ תְּ֝שֻׁבֹ֗ת אָֽוֶן׃ בְּאַנְשֵׁי־
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇî ’î·yō·wḇ yib·bā·ḥên ‘aḏ- ne·ṣaḥ ‘al- tə·šu·ḇōṯ ’ā·wen bə·’an·šê-
verses.literal: If only Job were tried to the utmost for answering like a wicked man

verses.original: כִּ֥י יֹ֘סִ֤יף פֶ֭שַׁע עַֽל־ חַטָּאת֣וֹ יִסְפּ֑וֹק בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ וְיֶ֖רֶב אֲמָרָ֣יו לָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî yō·sîp̄ p̄e·ša‘ ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw yis·pō·wq bê·nê·nū wə·ye·reḇ ’ă·mā·rāw lā·’êl
verses.literal: For he adds rebellion to his sin he claps [his hands] among us and multiplies his words against God
